race.title: OLBG Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: SPIRITS BAY often goes well fresh and looks a potential class angle in a wide-open renewal. He narrowly shades the vote over race-fit and unexposed Zarakerjack , while Faivoir would be interesting if supported from a slipping mark. SPIRITS BAY ZARAKERJACK (FR) FAIVOIR (FR)
